name: GPT Image by Ace Data Cloud
tagline: GPT Image generation, editing and task retrieval through Ace Data Cloud.
description: GPT Image tools provided by Ace Data Cloud, with your own Ace account. Uses the existing OpenAIMCP server, which also exposes chat/audio tools; this is not an image-only permission boundary. Install the existing remote MCP server, then authorize OAuth or configure your own API Token as described in the guide. Generation and editing may be charged; query the same task ID for pending results. This is an Ace-maintained integration, not a third-party official connector.

install.notes: After installation, open the Cline MCP manager and authorize the server through OAuth. Alternatively, follow the guide to register/sign in to Ace, open Applications → General application, copy or create a dedicated API Token, and add one Authorization: Bearer header in your private user MCP settings. Do not use both fixed headers and OAuth. Check current service pricing and balance before generating. Guide: https://github.com/AceDataCloud/OpenAIMCP/blob/b057f0420e43fd0d0d1f05d52fee1f5a95471b14/docs/cline-gpt-image.md
